entities.name: Celtic Iron Age & the Gaelic World
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Celtic (Gaelic) culture and La Tène art pervaded Ireland. The emergence of túatha (petty kingdoms), druids, brehon law, and legendary high kingship at Tara. Ireland remained outside the Roman Empire, preserving a unique Celtic civilisation.
